The Leibniz-Lab **“Systemic Sustainability” ([LL-SYSTAIN](https://www.ll-systain.org/))**, funded by the Leibniz Association, started in April 2024 and runs until March 2027. Dr. Amit Kumar Srivastava is co-coordinator and principal investigator.
